prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for lavender tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single small ceramic cup with a soft pale-lavender tinted infusion inside, placed slightly off-center (upper left). Scattered around the cup on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: three or four fresh purple lavender stalks with their characteristic small clustered florets (deep violet to soft lilac gradient along each stalk), two slim sage-green leaves, and a few tiny loose dried lavender buds. The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Lavender stalks and leaves have clean confident silhouettes, not painterly brushstrokes. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The cup has a subtle pale-violet glazed rim. Palette stays in soft sage-greens and muted purples — no oversaturation. Warm diffuse morning light from upper left casts a faint soft shadow below the cup and stalks. Feels calm, dreamy, sleep-inducing. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes. Match composition and rendering style of tea-card-chamomile.
